name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by his grandfather's tales of racing legends. He spent his formative years tinkering with engines in his family's workshop, developing a knack for precision and problem-solving. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he honed his skills in various racing teams, quickly establishing himself as a highly sought-after machinist known for his meticulous approach.

His unwavering commitment to perfection sets him apart. Ricardo believes that every component, no matter how small, plays a critical role in achieving peak performance. He approaches each task with a blend of technical expertise, creative thinking, and an unyielding determination to push the boundaries of what's possible. He is a firm believer in continuous learning and eagerly embraces new technologies to enhance his craft. Ricardo's ambition extends beyond personal success; he dreams of contributing to a championship-winning team and leaving a lasting legacy in the world of motorsport.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point.
Has a lucky wrench he uses for critical tasks.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day.
